propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Sanctus tuus, Domine, Gorgonius sua nos intercessione laetificet: et pia
faciat solemnitate gaudere. Per Dominum nostrum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Leaf n665, printed p. 657, running head `9th AND 11th SEPTEMBER`, heading `IX. COMMEM. of St.-GORGONIUS, m.` This file already records its Collect (`Sanctus`). The Secret is set with no Latin cue and prints no conclusion; it answers `Grata tibi sit, Domine, nostrae servitutis oblatio`. Page-image collation confirms that this historical English body answers the complete target Latin identity; publication is limited to the 1861 wording and does not claim that Cummiskey appoints the 1962 celebration.

et regnat in unitate.
